overview_title: Breathing New Life into Old Code.
overview_desc_1: We transform outdated, monolithic applications into modern, scalable, and secure cloud-native platforms. Our modernization strategies ensure your business logic is preserved while your infrastructure is future-proofed.
overview_desc_2: Eliminating technical debt allows your team to innovate faster, reduces maintenance costs, and improves overall system security and performance.

problem.title: Stagnant Legacy
problem.desc: Brittle systems that are expensive to maintain, impossible to scale, and vulnerable to modern security threats.

solution.title: Strategic Evolution
solution.desc: Incremental refactoring and replatforming that moves your core assets to modern stacks without interrupting business operations.

benefits.title: Cloud Replatforming
benefits.desc: Moving on-premise monolithic applications to flexible, cost-effective cloud environments.

benefits.title: Microservices Breakout
benefits.desc: Decomposing giant codebases into small, independent services for easier maintenance and deployment.

benefits.title: Database Migration
benefits.desc: Migrating legacy data stores to modern, high-performance relational or NoSQL databases with zero corruption.

benefits.title: Frontend Refresh
benefits.desc: Replacing outdated web interfaces with modern, responsive, and high-performance React or Next.js frontends.

benefits.title: Security Hardening
benefits.desc: Integrating modern identity management and encryption protocols into legacy business logic layers.

benefits.title: CI/CD Implementation
benefits.desc: Automating manual deployment processes to reduce human error and increase release frequency.

process.title: Technical Debt Audit
process.desc: Analyzing existing codebase for vulnerabilities, bottlenecks, and obsolete dependencies.

process.title: Strangler Pattern
process.desc: Implementing new features in modern stacks while slowly replacing old modules over time.

process.title: Data Migration
process.desc: Scripting and validating the transfer of critical business data to new schemas.

process.title: Phased Cutover
process.desc: Seamless switching from the old system to the new platform with minimal downtime.
